name: Bipolar Depression Rating Scale (BDRS)
directions: Clinician-rated for current symptoms or the last few days. For sleep and appetite, rate either the decrease or increase direction as instructed by the source form. This scale includes a suicide item; endorsement opens the safety support pathway. It is not diagnostic.

questions.definition: Rate observed or reported gloom, sadness, pessimism, hopelessness or helplessness.

Select one direction. Insomnia: reduction in total sleep time (mild up to 2 h; moderate 2–4 h; severe over 4 h). Hypersomnia: increase in total sleep time including daytime sleep (mild under 2 h/non-restorative; moderate over 2 h; severe over 4 h).
Select one direction. Loss: from pushing oneself to eat to marked reduction. Increase: from increased hunger to marked increase/cravings.
0 nil; 1 life not worthwhile/meaningless; 2 thoughts of death without active suicide thoughts or plans; 3 thoughts or plans of suicide.

attribution: Bipolar Depression Rating Scale (BDRS); use and score according to the supplied authorized form and manual.
